title: The Green Hand
text: A hand of living vine reaches up out of a well, green and supple, leaves unfurling at the knuckles. It opens, palm up, patient. It will take the hurt from any wounded arm laid in it, a voice from the well says. It does not say what it gives back.

options.label: The one with the hurt arm lays it in the vine's palm, trusting the voice in the well.

outcomes.text: The vine knits the arm, green and gentle, then lets go. It leaves a leaf in the wound that never quite falls out.
The vine takes the arm's strength instead of its hurt, sighing with pleasure.

options.label: Healer's hands ask the well its name, one healer to another.

outcomes.text: It answers, then teaches a little of its green craft.

options.label: Burn it out of the well. Nothing green should reach from the dark.

outcomes.text: It screams like a child as it burns. The ash is worth something.
